snippet.title: Hades II Coming to Xbox Game Pass – Official Announce Trailer | Xbox Partner Preview 2026
snippet.description:
Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel on April 14.

Hades II is coming to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC as an Xbox Play Anywhere title and with Xbox Game Pass.
